search_window.basis: Latest prior independently fetched Food Line watch heartbeat to current execution. Recent prior-day results allowed only to catch late indexing; older incidents were not classified as new.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting a community's only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended because of storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food-bank closure or major food-access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_queries: "sole grocery store" fire closure November 2026 community
"food distribution" suspended power outage flood November 2026
SNAP EBT outage interruption November 14 2026 state
WIC EBT benefits suspended outage November 13 14 2026 agency
coverage_notes.search_limitations: Queries mostly returned 2025 incidents, older closures, planned or ordinary services, unrelated outages, or earlier policy changes. Search indexing can lag recent local notices. This is not an exhaustive nationwide collector.
